href.description: Link for a page. Without it, pages are buttons and onPageChange is called.

siblings.description: Pages shown each side of this one before an ellipsis.

labels.description: Show "Previous" and "Next" as words, not only arrows.

simple.description: Previous, "Page 2 of 10", Next — no page numbers.

examples.title: Basic
examples.description: Arrows, the first and last page, and the pages around this one. Gaps show an ellipsis.

examples.title: With labels
examples.description: "Previous" and "Next" as words. At the first page, Previous is disabled.

examples.title: Simple
examples.description: Just Previous and Next with the page count, for phones and feeds.

a11y: A <nav> named "Pagination" with a list of links.
This page has aria-current="page"; screen readers say "current page".
Arrow-only links have an aria-label ("Previous page", "Next page").
At the first or last page the link is disabled with aria-disabled="true" and no href, so it can't be followed or focused.
Every page link is at least 36 by 36 pixels.
